description: Part-to-whole as packed circles: each item is a circle whose area shows its value, and the optional per-item path (1 to 3 group names, top down) nests the circles inside outlined group circles, so a budget, a skills inventory or a folder tree reads as clusters. Laid out by d3-hierarchy pack() (circle packing: the front-chain placement of packSiblings and the smallest enclosing circle of packEnclose, padding 3) on the server, so there is no script. A group's hue follows its top-level group and a deeper circle is a lighter shade of it; group circles are outlined, leaf circles are filled. Every circle carries its name, path, value and share in a hover title and in the hidden table (item, path, value, share of total), and the aria label gives the total, the number of groups and the largest item. A leaf name (and its value, in a wider container) is drawn inside the circle where it fits, and a group name at the top of its circle where it fits; both are 12 px text gated on the container width. Motion-ready: every moving value reads --p (build progress 0 to 1, default 1) through a per-depth --k, so a motion_timeline track on p builds it level by level from the groups inward and the standalone render is the finished picture; reduced motion shows the end state.
